query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
                    FROM chat_messages
                    WHERE room_id = $1
                      AND deletion_source IS DISTINCT FROM $6
                      AND status <> $2
                      AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id <> $3)
                      AND (created_at, id) > ($4, $5)
                      AND NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM user_blocks ub
                            WHERE ub.blocker_user_id = $3 AND ub.blocked_user_id = user_id
                          )
